text:
Alex (Sales): Heads-up — HelioBank just dropped a vendor assessment (SIG/CAIQ-style) and wants POC scope + pricing. Need security + SE triage. Asked for answers by EOW.

Maria (Security): On it. Can you upload the questionnaire to the secure intake bucket? Also need customer tier and data classification to prioritize.

Alex (Sales): Done — uploaded here: https://files.redwood.internal/secure/heliobank-sig-2412.zip (internal link). Customer = Enterprise finance, PCI scope, PII in requests. They're asking for an estimated committed monthly cost for a Dedicated POC.

Jordan (Solutions): We can run a 2-week Dedicated POC. Two options: 1xA100 baseline or 2xA10G for parallel throughput. Need expected qps and typical seq len to nail cost. For strict PCI/no cloud egress we should propose Private on-prem; otherwise Dedicated + KMS is acceptable.

Maria (Security): Quick Qs for Alex: any existing MSAs/DPAs/BAAs signed? Also list of controls they flagged (encryption at rest/in-transit, MFA, RBAC, audit logs, SOC2 evidence).

Alex (Sales): They agreed to our standard DPA earlier — I'll re-send a copy to legal. No BAA yet. Their checklist calls out full disk and object encryption, role-based access, and 90-day log retention.

Sam (Support): Assigning ticket SEC-4521 and linking this thread. @Maria (Security) I'm assigning you as owner. I'll attach a POC checklist to the ticket (milestones, validation tests, rollback plan).

Maria (Security): Thanks — prioritizing high-risk items first. Aiming to draft answers for the questionnaire by Thu EOD. Jordan: can you confirm KMS/HSM options for runtime keys so I can reuse canonical answers?

Jordan (Solutions): Confirmed: we support cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) for Hosted/Dedicated, and customer-supplied HSM or key-wrapping for Private/on-prem installs. For Dedicated we offer customer-managed KMS integration. Example config we'll provide: 
```yaml
kms:
  provider: aws
  key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```

Alex (Sales): Customer wants a redlined questionnaire + POC pricing by Fri 5pm PT. Can we hit that? :pray:

Maria (Security): We will prioritize. Draft answers by Thu EOD; final redline dependent on Jordan's resource estimate.

Jordan (Solutions): I'll run the cost model and resource plan today and post numbers by tomorrow noon (commit size, burst cost delta, storage).

security-bot: Ticket SEC-4521 created and reminders set for Thu 18:00 and Fri 16:00.

Sam (Support): :thumbsup: I'll ping legal about the DPA re-send and flag for priority review.

Alex (Sales): Thanks team — I'll prep a short update to the customer once we have the draft. Ping me if anything blocks.
